 A 40-year-old Ocala man died after his sedan veered off the road and struck the stopped bus in Marion County
 By
 Christina Dugan Ramirez Fox News 
 Published
 November 16, 2026 4:38pm EST Comments

 John Summit's tour bus was reportedly involved in a fatal crash in Florida. (Getty Images; Florida Highway Patrol) 
 NEW You can now listen to Fox News articles!
 A tour bus reportedly carrying members of American DJ and electronic music producer John Summit’s crew was involved in a fatal crash in Florida on Monday.
 A 40-year-old Ocala man died after his Toyota sedan veered off the roadway and struck the front of a stopped tour bus in Marion County, the Florida Highway Patrol confirmed in a statement to Fox News Digital. The bus driver and all nine adult passengers were uninjured.
 Troopers said the sedan was traveling east before veering off the road and hitting the bus, which was stopped facing north. The man was transported to a local hospital, where he was pronounced dead.
 SINGER SAWYER HILL’S TOUR BUS FLIPS IN DEADLY CRASH, KILLING DRIVER AND INJURING CREW 
 John Summit's tour bus was reportedly involved in a fatal crash in Florida. (Getty Images; Florida Highway Patrol) 
 The crash remains under investigation.

 According to TMZ , Summit was not on the bus at the time of the crash.
 The crash followed Summit’s recent criticism of the Recording Academy after he was shut out of the 2027 Grammy nominations on Monday.
 John Summit was not on the bus during the crash. (Getty Images for SiriusXM)

 "Not saying the artists nominated aren’t good, they’re just not dance music, they’re pop," he wrote in a subsequent post on X .
